checked.target: AC1 stored best shown at start
checked.how: race-ui.ts reset(): bestLapMs = bestLaps.read(info.trackId); game.ts:253 now passes trackId: track.id; localBestLaps.read parses racer.bestLap.<id> via bestLapKey. 41020 -> formatOptionalTime -> 0:41.02.

checked.target: AC2 store on faster/no best, other tracks untouched, next race
checked.how: sync() loop: a lap is a new best when state.bestLapMs is null or ms < it; then write(race.trackId, ms) with ms = ticksToMs(ticks) (test checks ticks*1000/60 to 1e-6). Only bestLapKey(race.trackId) is written. On the next startRace, reset() reads it again.
Laps where ms >= state.bestLapMs hit `continue` before the write and before newBestTick is set, so the stored '1000' stays, the HUD shows 0:01.00 and the chip phase stays null.

Sim race.ts:73: lapStartTick starts at 0 (GO), so sum(lapTicks) is the raceTick at lap end, which equals newBestTick. Phase is 'out' while since < ceil((slide+2000)*60/1000) and 'back' until ceil((2slide+2000)*60/1000), then null. game.ts keeps stepping the world after finish (NO_INPUT), so raceTick advances. reset() calls hud.newBest(null).

checked.target: AC4/AC5 non-best lap and results label
checked.how: Laps that aren't a best never set newBestTick. results.show gets newBest: newBestTick !== null and bestLapMs: raceBestMs (this race's min). results-screen bestLabel switches between 'New best lap' and 'Best lap'. The new-best--results screenshot shows 'NEW BEST LAP 0:40.37'.

best-laps.ts read/write each wrap both the window.localStorage access and getItem/setItem in try/catch. read returns null and write drops. The HUD still takes this race's laps because state.bestLapMs starts null.
parse(): Number('abc') is NaN, -5 and 0 fail ms > 0, so each returns null. The HUD shows dashes, and the first lap writes and sets newBestTick.

new-best.stage.ts has hud and results states. raceStage passes memoryBestLaps({[id]:41200}) and trackId, so a 2422-tick lap (40367ms) beats it. The HUD sync at raceTick 2452 is 30 ticks after the lap, so the chip is out. Screenshots new-best--hud and new-best--results at 844x390 show both chips.

checked.target: Playtest: slide under BEST, TIME never moves, reduced motion
checked.how: hud.css: the chip stays in flow under BEST (no gap in .ui-hud__timer). Only transform and visibility change, and BEST has z-index 1 inside an isolated stack, so TIME's layout never changes. Under prefers-reduced-motion the transition is none and is-back is visibility:hidden (a cut).
The value is in localStorage under racer.bestLap.<trackId>. The RACE button (game.ts:136) starts menuTrack, and reset reads the stored best before any lap. Storage failures are swallowed (see AC6).
